root_resolution.note: ك ي ف occurs four times but is explicitly omitted by 02-branches.json as a nonbranchable QAC function root. The basmala is included in the analysis frame.

graph_discipline: Roots remain nodes; branches are activation labels or ports, not graph nodes.
surface_mechanism: 88:15-16 presents cushions arranged in rows and carpets spread out.
88:17-20 repeats contemplative looking and how-questions across camel creation, raised sky, erected mountains, and the earth spread flat.
88:21-22 moves from observation to reminder while explicitly denying coercive oversight.
The basmala reinforces divine creation, mercy, remembrance, and non-coercive guidance within the supplied inventory.
